verdict.rationale: LangSmith has an official MCP server (langsmith-mcp-server), and its docs say traces can be filtered, exported, and compared via the API, so an agent can programmatically query trace data to debug an app. The evidence does not describe what the MCP server exposes, and it never explicitly shows metrics or eval/experiment results being retrievable by API. The OpenAPI probe also found no spec at the common docs paths. missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage (traces, metrics, evals), explicit API access to dashboard metrics and experiment/eval results, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven querying.
